description: Mynt's treasury template (workspaces/coding-build/templates/solana-treasury) as CI's solana-treasury job builds it: verifiably, in Anchor's pinned image, with Mynt's own build script. program_sha256 is the sha256 of the program's bytes with trailing zero bytes stripped, the way Mynt hashes a build and a deployed program. CI fails when the build doesn't match, so a change to the template, its Cargo.lock or the toolchain needs a review and a new hash here. Mynt reads it to verify pools' programs: at declared_id against program_sha256, at any other id against its own rebuild of the template there (src/treasury-template.ts); earlier_builds lists builds still deployed and the deposit approval layout each checks. Devnet only: the mainnet program gate refuses this program.

earlier_builds.note: The build before MYNTDEP3: its approvals name no amount and can be reused until they expire. Pools registered on it keep MYNTDEP2 on devnet; mainnet never takes it.
